title: Trials, coupons and promotions
goal: Support free trials and coupon/promotion codes: eligibility rules, trial status handling, and `POST /v1/workspaces/{id}/coupons/redeem` backed by Stripe promotion codes.
scope_in: `POST /v1/workspaces/{id}/coupons/redeem` (scope `billing:write`, roles owner/billing, `Idempotency-Key` accepted) with body `{code: string}`.
Validation of promotion codes against Stripe (active, not expired, redemption limits, applicable plan, first-time-only restrictions) and application to the workspace's subscription or customer.

Trial eligibility service `trialEligibility(workspaceId, userId)`: one trial per workspace and per owner user, configurable length `TRIAL_DAYS` (default 14), trial applies to a plan from the default plans table.
Handling of Stripe `customer.subscription.trial_will_end` (3 days before) to send an email via B032 and a webhook `billing.subscription.updated` event.
Redemption ledger table for audit, abuse detection and idempotent replay.
scope_out: Creating the Stripe subscription or checkout (B070, B071); this lane exposes `trialEligibility` and a coupon-application function they call.
Entitlement values per plan (B069) and status behaviour of `trialing` (B080 reads it).
Admin tooling to issue coupons (B087 may call `grantPromotion`).
build_against: Stripe provider abstraction from B070 with a fake that supports promotion-code lookup and subscription update; fixtures for valid, expired, exhausted, wrong-plan and already-used codes.
interfaces: HTTP `POST /v1/workspaces/{id}/coupons/redeem` body `{code}` -> 200 with the updated subscription summary (same shape as `GET /v1/workspaces/{id}/subscription`) and `Idempotency-Replayed` on replay.
`trialEligibility(workspaceId: string, userId: string): Promise<{eligible: boolean; reason?: 'already_used'|'workspace_paid'; days: number}>`.
`grantPromotion(workspaceId: string, promotionCodeId: string, actor: Actor): Promise<Subscription>` for internal callers.
Table `coupon_redemptions(id, workspace_id, user_id, code_hash, stripe_promotion_id, redeemed_at, request_fingerprint)`; `UNIQUE(workspace_id, stripe_promotion_id)`.
acceptance: Redeeming a valid code as owner returns 200, the subscription reflects the discount, one audit event `billing.coupon.redeemed` is written, and a `rev` bump occurs only if entitlements changed.
Replaying the same `Idempotency-Key` and body returns the stored 200 with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` and applies the coupon once; same key with a different code returns 409 `idempotency_conflict`.
An invalid, expired, exhausted or already-redeemed code returns 422 problem+json with a `errors[0].pointer` of `/code`; the response never reveals which condition failed beyond a generic detail.
A `member` or `guest` caller gets 403 `forbidden`; caller of a different workspace gets 404/403.
More than 10 redeem attempts per workspace per hour (valid or not) returns 429 with `Retry-After`; the counter is per workspace and per IP.
A second trial for the same workspace or the same owner user is refused by `trialEligibility` (`already_used`); a workspace with a paid subscription is refused (`workspace_paid`).
The raw code is never stored or logged; only `sha256` of the normalised (trim, upper-case) code is persisted.
tests: unit: code normalisation and hashing; eligibility truth table.
integration: redeem happy path and replay with the Stripe fake.
abuse test: brute-force 11 attempts in an hour -> 429 on the 11th.
failure-path: Stripe timeout -> 503 with `retry_after_s`, no ledger row, safe to retry with the same key.
contract: error bodies conform to CT-ERR; `Idempotency-Key` behaviour conforms to CT-PAGE.
guardrails: MUST NOT reveal whether a code exists; failures return the same status and detail text.
MUST NOT store plaintext coupon codes anywhere (DB, logs, audit events).
MUST apply a coupon at most once per workspace per promotion even under concurrent requests (DB unique constraint plus Stripe idempotency key).
MUST NOT grant trial status without Stripe confirming the trial subscription state.
failure_modes: Stripe error after ledger insert -> roll back the ledger row in the same transaction, return 503, client may retry with the same key.
Trial ends without payment method -> Stripe moves the subscription; this lane relies on B072/B078 for the resulting status, no special handling.
Concurrent redeem of one single-use code by two workspaces -> exactly one succeeds, other gets the generic 422.
